fullText.simplified:
第四十二章、危急时刻

    三个人在蓬莱阁里发现了一块特殊的石头，让石文谦和简西意想不到的是，李主任直接伸手拿起了那块石头。这一刻，时间不再静止，而是流动了起来。
    简西转头向蓬莱阁外查看了一番，现在不止是地面，所有墙壁都开始流出大量的水银。同时，所有人都感受到了一阵晃动，整个空间好像随时会塌陷一般。
    “不好了，文谦！快想办法！”简西喊道。
    李主任也是一惊，他迟疑了一下，把石头放回原位，问道：“你有办法出去吗？”
    “本来没有。不过，简西给了我提示。”石文谦简短回答道，同时他感觉空间的晃动减弱了。
    “我？”简西一愣。
    “对。整个空间的建造运用了五行的原理，顺着这个思路，我们就能找到出口。”没有时间解释太多，石文谦点到为止。
    虽然只是短短的一句话，却让李主任心领神会，他瞬间就猜到了出口的位置。
    “厉害啊！文谦。”说完李主任的眼神再次变得冰冷，露出了不惜一切代价的架势，说道：“我还是要带走它，对不起了。”
    只见李主任迅速伸手，一把抓起了柱子上的石头。本来变回平稳的空间，再次剧烈晃动起来。石文谦眼神一沉，准备上前阻止。只见李主任抓住石头后，一个转身，用力推了一把旁边的简西。
    一切发生得太突然，简西吓了一跳，但身体已经失去了平衡。她摔倒在蜡烛群中，烛火烧着了简西的衣服，情况十分危急。石文谦见这情形，也顾不上再去抢石头，立刻脱掉自己的外套，扑打向简西身上的火苗。再看李主任这边，他正好利用了这个时间，握紧石头，顺利地跑出了蓬莱阁。
    解决了烧着的火苗，没想到还有更糟糕的情况。等石文谦和简西站起来，发现蓬莱阁的大门正在渐渐关闭，留给他们的时间太短了。
    “怎么会这样？”简西有点儿慌了。
    “说明大海已经全部被水银吞没。水的元素消失，五行平衡消失。”石文谦拉着简西使劲儿往蓬莱阁的大门方向跑。
    来不及了，真的来不及了，大门差一点就要完全关上了！这意味着他们两个人会被困在蓬莱阁里，随着整个空间的塌陷而丧命。
    石文谦眼看大门一寸寸关上，几乎能听到自己的心跳声——“不可以！我们不能死在这！”
    就在这紧急的时刻，一个身体挡住了大门。是他！怎么会是他？

第四十二章、危急時刻

    三個人在蓬萊閣裡發現了一塊特殊的石頭，讓石文謙和簡西意想不到的是，李主任直接伸手拿起了那塊石頭。這一刻，時間不再靜止，而是流動了起來。
    簡西轉頭向蓬萊閣外查看了一番，現在不止是地面，所有牆壁都開始流出大量的水銀。同時，所有人都感受到了一陣晃動，整個空間好像隨時會塌陷一般。
    “不好了，文謙！快想辦法！”簡西喊道。
    李主任也是一驚，他遲疑了一下，把石頭放回原位，問道：“你有辦法出去嗎？”
    “本來沒有。不過，簡西給了我提示。”石文謙簡短回答道，同時他感覺空間的晃動減弱了。
    “我？”簡西一愣。
    “對。整個空間的建造運用了五行的原理，順著這個思路，我們就能找到出口。”沒有時間解釋太多，石文謙點到為止。
    雖然只是短短的一句話，卻讓李主任心領神會，他瞬間就猜到了出口的位置。
    “厲害啊！文謙。”說完李主任的眼神再次變得冰冷，露出了不惜一切代價的架勢，說道：“我還是要帶走它，對不起了。”
    只見李主任迅速伸手，一把抓起了柱子上的石頭。本來變回平穩的空間，再次劇烈晃動起來。石文謙眼神一沉，準備上前阻止。只見李主任抓住石頭後，一個轉身，用力推了一把旁邊的簡西。
    一切發生得太突然，簡西嚇了一跳，但身體已經失去了平衡。她摔倒在蠟燭群中，燭火燒著了簡西的衣服，情況十分危急。石文謙見這情形，也顧不上再去搶石頭，立刻脫掉自己的外套，撲打向簡西身上的火苗。再看李主任這邊，他正好利用了這個時間，握緊石頭，順利地跑出了蓬萊閣。
    解決了燒著的火苗，沒想到還有更糟糕的情況。等石文謙和簡西站起來，發現蓬萊閣的大門正在漸漸關閉，留給他們的時間太短了。
    “怎麼會這樣？”簡西有點兒慌了。
    “說明大海已經全部被水銀吞沒。水的元素消失，五行平衡消失。”石文謙拉著簡西使勁兒往蓬萊閣的大門方向跑。
    來不及了，真的來不及了，大門差一點就要完全關上了！這意味著他們兩個人會被困在蓬萊閣裡，隨著整個空間的塌陷而喪命。
    石文謙眼看大門一寸寸關上，幾乎能聽到自己的心跳聲——“不可以！我們不能死在這！”
    就在這緊急的時刻，一個身體擋住了大門。是他！怎麼會是他？

sentences.english: There was no time left, truly no time left. The door was about to close completely!

sentences.simplified: 这意味着他们两个人会被困在蓬莱阁里，随着整个空间的塌陷而丧命。
sentences.traditional: 這意味著他們兩個人會被困在蓬萊閣裡，隨著整個空間的塌陷而喪命。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yì wèi zhe tā men liǎng ge rén huì bèi kùn zài péng lái gé lǐ suí zhe zhěng gè kōng jiān de tā xiàn ér sàng mìng
sentences.english: This meant that the two of them would be trapped in Penglai Pavilion and would perish as the entire space collapsed.

sentences.simplified: 石文谦眼看大门一寸寸关上，几乎能听到自己的心跳声——
sentences.traditional: 石文謙眼看大門一寸寸關上，幾乎能聽到自己的心跳聲——
sentences.pinyin: shí wén qiān yǎn kàn dà mén yí cùn cùn guān shàng jī hū néng tīng dào zì jǐ de xīn tiào shēng
sentences.english: As Shi Wenqian watched the door close inch by inch, he could almost hear his own heartbeat—

sentences.simplified: “不可以！我们不能死在这！”
sentences.traditional: “不可以！我們不能死在這！”
sentences.pinyin: bù kě yǐ wǒ men bù néng sǐ zài zhè
sentences.english: “No, it can’t be! We can’t die here!”

sentences.simplified: 就在这紧急的时刻，一个身体挡住了大门。是他！怎么会是他？
sentences.traditional: 就在這緊急的時刻，一個身體擋住了大門。是他！怎麼會是他？
sentences.pinyin: jiù zài zhè jǐn jí de shí kè yí ge shēn tǐ dǎng zhù le dà mén shì tā zěn me huì shì tā
sentences.english: In that urgent moment, a body blocked the door. It was him! How could it be him?

sentence_translations: Chapter 42: Critical Moment
The three of them discovered a special stone inside Penglai Pavilion.
To the surprise of Shi Wenqian and Jian Xi, Director Li immediately reached out and picked up the stone.
At this moment, time no longer stood still but began to flow.
Jian Xi turned her head to check outside Penglai Pavilion.
Now, not only the ground, but also all the walls began to flow with a large amount of mercury.
At the same time, everyone felt a tremor, as if the entire space might collapse at any moment.
“Something’s wrong, Wenqian! Quickly think of something!” Jian Xi shouted.
Director Li was also taken aback.
He hesitated for a moment, put the stone back in its original position, and asked, “Do you have a way to get out?”
“I didn’t at first. However, Jian Xi gave me a hint,” Shi Wenqian replied briefly, while he felt the tremor in the space begin to subside.
“Me?” Jian Xi was taken aback.
“Yes. The entire construction of this space utilizes the principles of the five elements.
Following this line of thought, we can find the exit.” With no time to explain further, Shi Wenqian kept it brief.
Although it was just a brief sentence, Director Li understood without further explanation, ..
.. and he instantly guessed the location of the exit.
“Impressive! Wenqian.” After speaking, Director Li’s expression turned cold again.
He revealed an attitude of being willing to do whatever it takes, and said, “I still have to take it with me, I’m sorry.”
Director Li quickly reached out and grabbed the stone from the pillar.
The space that had originally returned to calm began to shake violently again.
Shi Wenqian’s expression darkened as he prepared to step forward to stop him.
Seeing Director Li grab the stone, he turned around and forcefully pushed Jian Xi aside.
Everything happened too suddenly, and Jian Xi was startled, but her body had already lost its balance.
She fell among the cluster of candles, and the flames ignited her clothes, putting her in a very dangerous situation.
Seeing this situation, Shi Wenqian could no longer think about grabbing the stone.
He immediately took off his own coat and beat at the flames on Jian Xi’s body.
Meanwhile, Director Li took advantage of this moment, gripping the stone tightly as he successfully ran out of Penglai Pavilion.
After putting out the flames, they didn’t expect that an even worse situation would arise.
By the time Shi Wenqian and Jian Xi stood up, ..
.. they realized that the main door of Penglai Pavilion was gradually closing, leaving them with very little time.
“How could this happen?” Jian Xi was a little flustered.
“This indicates that the entire sea has been engulfed by mercury.
The element of water has disappeared, and the balance of the five elements is lost.”
Shi Wenqian pulled Jian Xi and ran as fast as he could towards the main door of Penglai Pavilion.
There was no time left, truly no time left. The door was about to close completely!
This meant that the two of them would be trapped in Penglai Pavilion and would perish as the entire space collapsed.
As Shi Wenqian watched the door close inch by inch, he could almost hear his own heartbeat—
“No, it can’t be! We can’t die here!”
In that urgent moment, a body blocked the door. It was him! How could it be him?
